description: Actual results of running the Campus Customs five-agent team (gpt-6-luna via Portkey) on tickets 101-103 after resetting the working database. Built from output/audit_trail.json, the backend run results, and data/campus_customs_new.db.

tickets.subject: Bulldog tee
tickets.short_outcome: Size S tee is out of stock (0 on hand) and the only apparel vendor was blocked by overdue invoice 501. A human approved paying the $840 invoice, which unblocks the vendor. The backend then marked the ticket resolved, but the tee itself has not been ordered or delivered, and the customer reply is only a draft.

agents.boss: Called Inventory first because stock decides whether the order can ship. Then asked Accounting to verify the bill and Customer Service to draft a reply. Decided awaiting_human_approval for the $840 invoice payment.
agents.inventory: Found CC-TEE-WHITE size S has 0 on hand (shortfall 1). Identified Bulldog Print Co (apparel, 5-day lead time) as blocked by open invoice 501 ($840, 3 days overdue). Handed the bill to Accounting.
agents.accounting: Confirmed $3,400 in checking and prepared invoice 501 for human approval ($840, leaving $2,560). Its attempt to prepare a 1-tee purchase order was refused by the tool 3 times because the vendor still had an open invoice.
agents.customer_service: Drafted (did not send) a reply to Tauhid Zaman: size S is out of stock and there is no confirmed restock date. Re-verified the facts through Inventory first. The draft's apostrophes have a character-encoding glitch.

tools_used.outcome: ticket 101 loaded (1 x CC-TEE-WHITE size S, invoice 501)
size S: 0 on hand, needed 1, shortfall 1; cost $8, list $28
Bulldog Print Co, 5-day lead time, cannot ship (open invoice)
purchase order for 1 tee S refused 3 times: vendor 1 has open invoice 501

safeguards_triggered: 10 repeated tool calls served from the run cache
purchase order refused by the vendor-open-invoice rule

human_approvals.outcome: paid as payment #1; checking $3,400.00 -> $2,560.00; invoice 501 status paid

unresolved_issues: The tee has not been ordered: a new 1-tee purchase order (about $8) needs a follow-up agent run now that the vendor is unblocked.
The app cannot record received stock, so size S stays at 0 even after an order.
The customer reply is a draft only and needs its encoding glitch fixed before a person sends it.
Resolved is the backend's status after all requests were approved; it overstates the business outcome for the customer.

tickets.subject: Rent due
tickets.short_outcome: Facilities verified the landlord's notice against lease 1 ($2,400 due 2026-09-02, in 2 days). Accounting prepared the rent payment, and a human approved it. Rent is paid and the lease's next due date moved to 2026-10-02. Genuinely resolved.

agents.boss: Called Facilities first so the notice was verified before any payment. Decided awaiting_human_approval for the $2,400 rent.
agents.facilities: Checked lease 1: Chapel Street shop, landlord Elm City Properties, $2,400 due 2026-09-02, 2 days after the shop date, not overdue. Verdict: the notice is consistent (it states no amount). Handed the rent to Accounting.
agents.accounting: Confirmed $2,560 in checking and prepared the rent for human approval ($2,400, leaving $160).

tools_used.outcome: ticket 102 notice: 'Email: shop rent due in 2 days.'

human_approvals.outcome: paid as payment #2; checking $2,560.00 -> $160.00; lease 1 next_due 2026-10-02

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
tickets.short_outcome: Only 8 of 20 size-M hoodies are in stock. The 12-unit restock ($264) could not be covered by the $160 left after tickets 101 and 102, and the club named no discount. The Boss decided blocked. A human declined the unfunded purchase order, so no money moved and the ticket is in progress. Not resolved.

agents.boss: Called Accounting first (price override, so it checked margin and discount floor), then Inventory. Decided blocked: no price or discount specified, 8 of 20 in stock, restock $104 short. Advised no order or customer commitment.
agents.accounting: Reported cost $22, list $58, margin $36 per unit, floor $22, and checking $160. Prepared the 12-hoodie purchase order ($264), which the tool marked as insufficient funds (balance after -$104).
agents.inventory: Confirmed 8 on hand (shortfall 12). Found Bulldog Print Co can now ship (no open invoices), 5-day lead time. Handed the restock to Accounting.

unresolved_issues: Insufficient cash for the full 12-unit restock ($264 vs $160). The shop models no revenue, so funds cannot increase.
A smaller order (at most 7 x $22 = $154) would fit but needs a new agent run to prepare; none was run to avoid extra model usage.
The club's requested discount or price is unspecified, so no discount decision was made.
Customer Service was not called, so the Yale AI Club has no drafted reply.
The backend showed awaiting_approval for an unfundable request although the Boss said blocked (a status-mapping limitation).
